system.description:
CONCENTRATE MYRATHI

Your sensory filaments have learned the rhythms of creatures who were never born beneath the Bloom.
During your daily preparations, you may spend 10 minutes attuning yourself to a number of willing creatures equal to your Wisdom ability score, minimum 1.
Until your next daily preparations, those creatures may participate in the silent communication granted by your Nethri growth while within 60 feet of you. You must still share a language, and the normal restriction concerning complete isolation from the surrounding air remains.

Prerequisites Nethri growth

Use at daily preparation: name the creatures attuned (up to your Wisdom, minimum 1) — the card records them until your next choice.
